method: environment-only sketch-to-render, exact approved actors composited afterward
prompt:
Create ONE finished environment-only background for an existing 2D orthogonal tactical roguelike camp. This is a sketch-to-render edit of reference 1, not a new floor plan. Target exact landscape canvas 1792 x 1152 px, 28 columns by 18 rows, 64 pixels per square. Fill the entire canvas with the map, no margin or title.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. The flat schematic gives EXACT orthogonal geometry and room positions. Replace its flat colors with actual game scenery. Remove all labels, circles, letter markers, the grid overlay and the small player figure. Preserve the traversable regions and the four single-square door passages. Grey areas are floor, dark areas solid structure.
2. The small player is STYLE AND SCALE reference only. Its body is about 60 px high at the requested final canvas size. Do not reproduce the character in the result.
3. The large armorer illustration is MATERIAL / LINEWORK STYLE reference only: strong black outlines, broad angular cel-shaded surfaces, muted colored materials. Do not reproduce the person.

CAMERA AND STYLE:
Flat orthogonal overhead board with slightly front-visible shallow wall faces, parallel horizontal and vertical lines, square cells; match the existing 2D sprite game. NO isometric projection, NO perspective vanishing point, NO 3D rendering, NO realistic/painterly concept art. Crisp game-ready illustrated scenery, broad simple shapes, 2 or 3 shade values per material, strong dark outlines, very sparse edge wear. Details must remain readable alongside a 60-px-tall adult. Equipment such as a desk approximately 64-100 px wide; a medical bed around 55 x 115 px. Quiet charcoal, dirty olive, brown rust, dirty ivory, some muted desaturated teal. Stable upper-left lighting; contact shadows. No photorealistic floor noise, fine dense scratches, busy panel grids, dominant neon, bloom or cinematic lighting.

EXACT STRUCTURE:
The floor hallway is x64..1728, y448..704 (4 rows tall). Clear left arrival at x96,y544 and right exit x1696,y544, modest armored frames.
Top left room interior rectangle x256..704,y192..384, door opening x448..512,y384..448.
Top right room interior x1088..1536,y192..384, door x1280..1344,y384..448.
Bottom left room interior x256..704,y768..960, door x448..512,y704..768.
Bottom right room interior x1088..1536,y768..960, door x1280..1344,y704..768.
All other areas solid industrial structure with restrained wall surfaces and cutaway dark void. Thick wall structures should not resemble enormous floor areas. Show only the narrow wall rims bordering rooms/hallways and keep remaining void dark and unobtrusive.
Room floor positions x480,y320; x1312,y320; x480,y896; x1312,y896 must remain OPEN to later place NPCs. Hallway center around x800,y576 also OPEN to place the existing player.
Do not put props across the doors or hall.

DECOR CONTENT:
A grim oppressive cyberpunk refuge repurposed from a security facility, human scale, worn but functional. Top-left command post: a small stern mission desk/console and weapons locker against rear/left wall, no signage. Top-right armorer: work counter at rear, simple weapon racks and storage lockers along side walls. Bottom-left infirmary: an empty dirty-ivory medical cot at left, narrow cabinet and medical trolley near rear/right wall. Bottom-right technician workshop and storage: compact tool bench along rear/side wall, closed robust personal-storage chest at one side, a few ordered tool shapes. Short wall lamps, restrained cables along walls, chunky vent/grate accents, visible reinforced thresholds. Keep a lot of open floor so characters can move and their outlines stay clear. No decorative floor runes or magic travel effects yet.

HARD EXCLUSIONS: no people, NPCs, bodies, monsters, silhouettes, player sprites; no lettering, labels, words, UI, icons, diagrams, numbers, hex grids. No book/portrait sheet. One coherent map scene only.
